The '''Nebulon 7''' quadrant was an area of space around the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]] that was under control of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the wake of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The quadrant owed its name to the [[Nebulon 7]], one of the first factions who openly pledged support to the Alliance, in the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The area was saturated with [[YKL-37R Nova Courier|YKL-37R]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]], what the Rebels called the "Nova Couriers."
